 EVENT_INPUT
     INIT WITH THRESH; * Setzt Schwellwert *)

     INITO; (* Schwellwert gesetzt*)
     IND WITH PRESENT, GREEN; (* Änderung von Vorhandensein oder Farbe *)
END EVENT
VAR_INPUT
    THERESH : REAL;    (* Einstellbarer Farbenschwellwert *)

    PRESENT : BOOL;    (* Apfelsine ist da *)
    GREEN : BOOL;    (* Grün ist über dem Schwellwert *)

SE QUENCE setup
   ORANGE_SENSOR.INIT(THRESH) -> resource.init() -> ORANGE_SENSOR.INITO();
END_SEQUENCE
SE QUENCE sensing
   resource.change() -> ORANGE_SENSOR.IND(PRESENT,GREEN);
END_SEQUENCE
END_SEQUENCE
 END_FUNCTION BLOCK

// GET method
getAllPeriod(specificInfo) {
    var specificInfo = getSpecificInfo(specificInfo);
    var startDate = specificInfo.getStartDate();
    var endDate = specificInfo.getEndDate();
    var startPeriod = simplePeriod(specificInfo.getStartDate(), specificInfo.getStartDate());
    var endPeriod = simplePeriod(specificInfo.getEndDate(), specificInfo.getEndDate());
    var intervals = service.inInterval(startDate, endDate);
    var periodList = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < intervals.size; i++) {
        var period = simplePeriod(intervals.get(i));
        var periodStart = simplePeriod(startDate, startDate, period.start);
        var periodEnd = simplePeriod(endDate, startDate, period.end);
        periodList[i] = {period, periodStart, periodEnd};
    }
    return intervalList(periodList);
}

private Interval simplePeriod(Date start, Date end, String periodName) {
    return new Interval(start, end, true);
}

General comment: please use the full URL from which you want to build your

backbone. If you use the DOM from your WINDOW or profil you'll get an error.

If you want to build a new page from a CarbonServe server, use the quickStart

sample. simplePeriod parses "start", "end", "period", etc...

Beware that (uncritical) use of the resource attribute UI_LEFT_START or UI_RIGHT_START

can become so fixed
that it seriously affects your ability to use the XML functions `prettyxml()`, `timeline()`, and the WINDOW Y prefix (or extension) in non-BOM contexts such as in beans etc. In general, please try not to use labels if possible and instead add context statements anyways (for example <timeline context="WEB" / >)!

The URI that builds the server is `https://<your.domain.com>/plugins/SerpServer/system.xml`.

WINDOW/BULK labels are interpreted by CarbonServe Server as relative.
